rules.heading: THE DETERMINATION OF MINDAN A ON THE MOTHER'S BEING PREGNANT

planetary.freeform: If the conception of the mother is of more than 5 months duration, Mundana is prohibited; if the child is more than 5 years of age, Mundana is auspicious even if the mother is pregnant.

exclusions: mother's conception of more than 5 months duration
rules.notes: Mundana is prohibited if the mother's pregnancy exceeds 5 months, unless the child is older than 5 years.

rules.heading: EXCEPTION OF MALEFIC TARA IN DOING MUNDANA

planetary.freeform: Moon is in a Trine, in her own exaltation sign, in the Varga of friendly planets, in her own divisional chart, or in the sign of a Benefic Planet.

rules.notes: Malefic Taras (1/3/5/7th) become auspicious for mundana and travelling if the Moon is strongly placed in trines, own sign, friendly varga, or benefic sign.

rules.heading: THE TIME WHICH IS TO BE REJECTED IN THE MUNDANA OF THE ELDER SON

planetary.freeform: Month of Jyestha for eldest son's mundana; also month of Margashirsha according to some acharyas. Mother having menses or being Prasutika.

rules.notes: Mundana should not be performed when the mother is menstruating or recently delivered, and the eldest son's mundana is prohibited in Jyestha (and Margashirsha).
